verdict.rationale: Lago has its own revenue analytics feature, so analytics come from the billing platform itself rather than an external BI export. The only evidence is a single marketing line about per-customer dashboards, filtering and CSV export; none of the story's named metrics is documented. A community question about revenue reporting is only an open question, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: documented MRR computation, churn metrics, cohort retention analysis, LTV calculation, in-depth analytics docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I get MRR, churn, cohort retention, and LTV analytics computed from the billing source of truth, not a bolted-on BI export

citations.quote: Build custom dashboards per customer, filter any way you want and export to CSV.
